<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="persistent-details" name="Persistent details"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1400" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <object label="COLLECTION: empty
per-view; configured capacity" link="requirements-software.html#STV_SWR_063" linkTarget="_top" id="empty"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#ddeaf5;strokeColor=#425466;fontSize=16;spacing=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="300" x="40" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </object> <object label="COLLECTION: active
Need-ID insertion order; age fixed" link="requirements-software.html#STV_SWR_063" linkTarget="_top" id="active"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#ddeaf5;strokeColor=#425466;fontSize=16;spacing=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="300" x="700" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </object> <mxCell id="open" edge="1" parent="1" source="empty" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="active" value="new Details / append and load"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="clear" edge="1" parent="1" source="active" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;" target="empty" value="Close all, last Close or pagehide
remove entries"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="850" y="300" /> <mxPoint x="190" y="300" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="retain" edge="1" parent="1" source="active" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.8;entryY=1;" target="active" value="reuse: focus, retain age
new: evict oldest if full, append"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1190" y="90" /> <mxPoint x="1190" y="230" /> <mxPoint x="940" y="230" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <object label="ENTRY: loading
fresh identity, safe shared transport" link="requirements-software.html#STV_SWR_063" linkTarget="_top" id="loading"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#ddeaf5;strokeColor=#425466;fontSize=16;spacing=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="300" x="40" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </object> <object label="ENTRY: ready or error
current live entry only; no focus theft" link="requirements-software.html#STV_SWR_063" linkTarget="_top" id="ready"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#ddeaf5;strokeColor=#425466;fontSize=16;spacing=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="300" x="510" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </object> <object label="ENTRY: removed
late completions ignored" link="requirements-software.html#STV_SWR_063" linkTarget="_top" id="removed"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#ddeaf5;strokeColor=#425466;fontSize=16;spacing=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="300" x="1040" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </object> <mxCell id="loaded" edge="1" parent="1" source="loading" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="ready" value="same entry live
content or error"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="remove" edge="1" parent="1" source="ready" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="removed" value="Close, eviction or Close all"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cancel" edge="1" parent="1" source="loading" style="edgeStyle=none;html=0;endArrow=block;fontSize=14;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;" target="removed" value="remove while loading / invalidate entry"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="190" y="770" /> <mxPoint x="1190" y="770" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
